Rows 18-20 below it are darker (L=57-82), reading as shadow and the cushion's front face. The seat is wider (14 px) than the backrest (5 px). Below the seat are a pedestal and a caster base at rows 22-28. The backrest also has a lighter top band at rows 3-6, ending in a light edge line at row 6, above a darker face at rows 7-16. This matches the 'seat: top 5 + legs' reference, not the flat 'band 2' or the side-elevation chair.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate has 13 colours in total and a median of 13 per tile. That matches the simple references (bench 14, lamp 14, hedge 11 colours) and is close to the hedge's 10 per tile. Flat-fill coverage is 0% and none of the dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outline carries a tint. By eye it is a dark navy/blue-grey line beside the blue upholstery, and a dark grey-blue beside the base, not a sticker-style black line. The seat and backrest show roughly 4 lightness steps (highlight, mid, shade, deep) with some dithered variation. The base and casters are shaded in a few greys. It is a small, thin prop, so it is not penalised for being simple. It is slightly shallower than the richest references (stall, well) but is on par with the bench, hedge and lamp, and a careful artist would accept it beside them.
